_doc: Experiment A: fixed token count (num_predict configurable). The model receives a prompt that does NOT ask for a specific output length; the token-budget is enforced via Ollama's num_predict parameter. The prompt template is intentionally minimal so it does not bias the length of the generated text. We append the Qwen3 /no_think directive so that thinking-trace tokens do not consume the entire budget on Qwen-family models. The directive is a no-op for non-Qwen models.
